visualSource: Figma node 44:5 / SOURCE / Progression Run Approved
productionRule: The production screen is one reusable renderer. It accepts arbitrary progression data at runtime. Never create a separate Compose screen or hard-coded layout per progression.

trackRenderer.recyclingRule: Render only the visible window. Reuse orb slots as activeIndex changes so a 3-chord progression and a 64-chord progression use the same renderer.

advanceAnimation.behavior: Every visible chord orb moves one slot toward the play-point. The completed chord moves into previous history and dims. The next chord arrives at relativeIndex 0, grows to full scale, and becomes active. A new upcoming chord enters at the far end. The environment stays fixed.
advanceAnimation.interruptPolicy: Do not start a second advance while an advance animation is in progress. Queue at most one valid advance event.

requirements: Matcher evaluates the ChordEvent at activeIndex, not the text rendered in the orb.
Wrong or incomplete chords never advance the track.
Do not advance twice from the same held chord or sustain state.
Require a new qualifying note-state after each accepted advance.
Respect root, bass, inversion, omission and voicing-family policies defined by the ChordEvent.
The Figma click trigger is simulation only; production advancement comes from MIDI recognition or explicit manual Next.

assistanceModes.full_help: Show current chord plus multiple upcoming symbols and voicing guidance.
assistanceModes.symbol_only: Show chord symbols without keyboard/voicing guidance.
assistanceModes.audio_only: Hide upcoming symbols; reveal/advance based on heard target and MIDI answer.
assistanceModes.advanced: Show minimal look-ahead, optionally only one approaching orb.

endBehavior.loopFalse: When activeIndex reaches the final event and it is completed, run finish animation and show run results.
endBehavior.loopTrue: Recycle the first event into the far-upcoming slot and continue seamlessly without resetting the screen.

regions.dynamicBounds: Bind to TRACK SLOT / 0. Do not bind to a specific chord name.
